spells.notes: YS-era holdover on 1998-02-25..02-27. The cabinet reshuffle was announced 1997-08-05 (KBS, 경향신문) and the 임명장 was given on the morning of 1997-08-06 (연합뉴스), which matches the MOIS start date. The MOIS page lists his 퇴임 as 1998-03-02. Under 법률 제5529호 the 내무부 ceased to exist on 1998-02-28. 연합뉴스 1998-03-02 reports that 曺海寧 내무장관 stayed home on standby (비상대기) while no minister of the new 행정자치부 had been appointed, and 세계일보 1998-03-03 describes ministers 'dismissed under the new 정부조직법' still performing duties. The days 1998-02-28..03-02 are therefore recorded as a vacancy of 행정자치부 (see acting), not as part of this spell.
